description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_Compress_Bzip2 that provides methods for compressing and decompressing data using the bzip2 algorithm, with configurable parameters for block size, work level, and minimum length.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Bzip2
classes.description: A class providing bzip2 compression and decompression functionalities with configurable settings.

methods.name: getBlockSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current block size setting.

methods.name: setBlockSize
methods.description: Sets the block size for compression, with assertions on valid range.

methods.name: getWorkLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current work level setting.

methods.name: setWorkLevel
methods.description: Sets the work level for compression, with assertions on valid range.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum length for data to be compressed.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum length for data to be compressed.

methods.name: ADODB_Compress_Bzip2
methods.description: Constructor to initialize compression settings, optionally accepting block size, work level, and minimum length.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses the input data if it meets the minimum length requirement, using configured parameters.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decompresses the input data if it is not empty.
